objective: convert every major matrix weight to the lowest practical hard low-bit representation under the user-requested cumulative NLL-ratio ceiling 1.10
branch_role: experimental relaxed frontier; never replaces or rewrites the official strict frontier

quality_policy.warning: 1.10 NLL ratio is not 10 percent PPL; the PPL change is exp(candidate_nll-reference_nll)-1

per_block_strategy: try exact activation-weighted strict Q2 ternary for every unconverted group
if Q2 fails, add the minimum sensitivity-ranked Q4 rescue fraction
use Q8 only if no Q2/Q4 mixture passes
save a new immutable artifact and verify it in a fresh process before advancing
after_decoder_blocks: convert tied embedding and LM head without storing the tied weights twice
verify zero BF16 major matrix weights remain
lower Q8 to Q4 and Q4 to Q2 while the cumulative 1.10 gate holds
